headline: Software Is Beating Chips for Once. It May Not Be a Flash in the Pan.
summary: Enterprise software providers, many left behind in the artificial-intelligence boom, were the apparent beneficiaries of a pullback in chip and hardware stocks.  Workday  the human-resources software provider, was the top performer in the large-cap index on Monday, jumping 9.3%.  Altogether, the much-watched  exchange-traded fund, or IGV, rose 4%, while the  ETF, or SOXX, slumped 3.1%.
